title: Manual input modal opens in Teks AI mode when online
expected_result: "Teks AI" mode active; textarea empty with placeholder example; "0/500" counter

title: Text input is capped at 500 characters
expected_result: Input truncated at 500; counter turns red at 500/500

title: Submitting clear expense text saves a transaction
steps:
1. Type a clear expense sentence
2. Submit
expected_result: Modal closes, "Memproses...", then transaction saved + toast (SAVE-01); textarea cleared

title: Submitting empty or whitespace-only text does nothing
steps:
1. Leave the textarea empty or type only spaces
2. Submit
expected_result: No request sent, no transaction created

title: Low-confidence text result behaves like voice but with source text
preconditions: Teks AI mode open; input will yield low confidence
expected_result: Same as VOICE-09 (not saved, low-confidence modal, logged) but source = text and input_text populated

title: Submitting AI text while offline is blocked
preconditions: Device offline, Teks AI mode open
steps:
1. Type a valid expense sentence
2. Submit while offline
expected_result: Alert that AI text processing needs internet and suggests "Formulir Langsung"; no transaction created

title: Server/AI failure on text submit shows an alert and saves nothing
preconditions: Teks AI mode open; AI service will fail
steps: 1. Submit a valid expense sentence while the AI service is failing
expected_result: Alert "Gagal memproses teks. ..."; no transaction created

title: Cancel or close on manual input modal discards input
preconditions: Manual input modal open with text entered

title: Offline opens directly in Formulir Langsung mode
expected_result: Opens directly in "Formulir Langsung" mode labeled "(Offline)"; fully usable

title: Direct form has correct default values
expected_result: Kategori = Makan, Metode = QRIS, all other fields empty

title: Price field accepts digits only thousands-formatted and capped
steps:
1. Type "25000" into the price field
2. Attempt to exceed 999999999
expected_result: Only digits accepted; displays as "25.000"; capped at 999.999.999

title: Saving with empty or zero price is rejected
preconditions: Formulir Langsung mode open, price left empty or 0
steps:
1. Leave price empty (or 0)
2. Try to save
expected_result: Rejected without any browser-native validation message; red inline error "Jumlah pengeluaran wajib diisi." shown under the price field and the price field gets a red border; no transaction saved

title: Saving with only a valid price uses defaults for the rest
steps:
1. Enter only a valid price
2. Save
expected_result: Saved with kategori Makan, metode QRIS, empty platform, detail = category name; success toast

title: Saving with all fields filled saves exactly as entered
steps:
1. Fill price, platform, category, method, and note
2. Save
expected_result: Saved exactly as entered; detail = the note entered

title: Empty note with platform filled uses platform as detail
preconditions: Formulir Langsung mode open, platform filled, note empty
steps:
1. Fill platform, leave note empty
2. Save

title: Form resets after save for next use
steps:
1. Save a transaction via the direct form
2. Reopen the form
expected_result: Modal closed; price/platform/note cleared for the next entry

title: Direct-form transactions are always high confidence and never logged low-confidence
steps: 1. Save a transaction via the direct form
expected_result: Treated as high confidence; never produces a low-confidence log

title: Platform capped at 50 and Catatan at 200 characters with n/50 and n/200 counters in the direct form
steps:
1. Type or paste 60 characters into Platform
2. Type or paste 250 characters into Catatan
3. Check the counters above both fields
expected_result: Platform stops at 50 and Catatan at 200 (cannot type or paste more); counters "n/50" and "n/200" shown above the fields and turn red when full, like the AI-text input and edit modal
